description: A class that traverses and gathers artifact information from screen widget models in the Apache OFBiz framework. It inspects various widget components, model actions, forms, and related entities/services to collect metadata such as entity names, service names, screen locations, form locations, and request destinations.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoGatherer
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses widget model components to extract metadata such as entity names, service names, screen, form, and request locations, aiding in artifact documentation or analysis.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Implements the visitor pattern for various widget model components and actions, collecting relevant artifact data during the traversal.
methods.parameters: Different for each override, e.g., ModelScreen, Section, EntityAnd, etc.

methods.name: visitModelForm
methods.description: Processes a ModelForm object to collect entity, service, target locations, and fields' request locations, utilizing a nested FieldInfoGatherer for field-specific data.
